source:
@@U04659@@
What is not meant for you, You must abjure it; What harms the heart of you, You must not endure it! And if it force its way, Fight it we must and may, Only the one who loves Will lead to Heaven's day.

@@U04661@@
My head, my heart, my liver are afire! Ah! Crueler, crueler, worse than Hellfire, this Love, this Love, this super-devilish element! So this is why lovers moan when scorned by Love, and crack their necks for one glimpse of the loved one! As I, too, now! As I do now! What draws my head in that direction? My mortal enemy! Whose sight I abominated! What is it, what, has pierced me through and through? How lovely they appear to me now, those lovely boys! Why can’t I curse them? Ah! It sticks in my craw! Ah, once myself a fool for love, who can ever be a fool again? And yet I hate them, hate them— but love them, too, those loveliest, those tenderest of love-sweet boys!
translation:
@@U04659@@
不适合你的，你必须放弃它；伤你心的事，你绝对不能忍受！如果它强行闯入，我们必须也可以与之抗争，只有爱的人才能通向天堂。

@@U04661@@
我的头、我的心、我的肝都着火了！啊!比地狱火更残忍，更残忍，更可怕，这爱，这爱，这超魔元素！这就是为什么恋人们在被爱情蔑视时会呻吟，为了一睹所爱的人而扭断脖子！现在的我也一样！就像我现在一样！是什么吸引我的头朝那个方向发展？我的死敌！我厌恶谁的目光！到底是什么，什么，把我刺透了？现在我觉得他们是多么可爱啊，那些可爱的男孩们！为什么我不能诅咒他们？啊!它粘在我的小腿里了！啊，曾经为爱情傻过的自己，谁还能再傻呢？然而我恨他们，恨他们——但也爱他们，那些最可爱、最温柔的甜蜜男孩！
